title: NEM Flex Telemetry Record
description: A single 5-minute interval telemetry record from a participating household. Schema v2.0. See SCHEMA.md for full specification.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '2.0'. Records with any other value are rejected by the validator.

interval_start_utc.description: Interval start timestamp in UTC. Format: ISO8601 with Z suffix. Interval covers [interval_start_utc, interval_start_utc + 5 minutes).

postcode_prefix.description: First 3 digits of the household postcode. Privacy boundary.

net_import_kw.description: Net power import at the grid connection point. Positive = importing from grid, negative = exporting to grid. Units: kW.

solar_kw.description: Solar generation (kW, always >= 0). Current state value from the solar forecast entity.

house_load_kw.description: Inflexible base load (kW, >= 0). Derived as total_load_kw minus sum of deferrable current_kw, clamped to 0.

deferrable_load_kw.description: Sum of deferrable load current_kw (kW, >= 0). Zero for default v0.3 install (deferrable_loads[] is empty).

naive_baseline_kw.description: Estimated consumption (kW) without optimisation. Same sign convention as net_import_kw.

naive_baseline_method.description: Method used to derive naive_baseline_kw. 'subtraction' uses sensor.load_power as a proxy; 'haeo_counterfactual' uses the LP no-flex branch if HAEO exposes it.

price_signal_seen.description: Buy price signal seen by the optimiser ($/kWh). Range -2.0 to 20.0 covers extreme negative-FiT events to capacity-price spikes.

price_export_seen.description: Sell/export price seen by the optimiser ($/kWh). Positive = FiT earned; negative = negative-FiT event.

envelope_import_limit_kw.description: Maximum import allowed at this moment (kW), as tracked by the optimiser. From number.grid_import_limit.

envelope_export_limit_kw.description: Maximum export allowed at this moment (kW). Positive kW magnitude. From number.grid_export_limit.

flex_available_up_kw.description: Upward flexibility available (kW): additional load the household could absorb right now.

flex_available_down_kw.description: Downward flexibility available (kW): load reduction or export increase deliverable right now.

shadow_energy_price.description: Cross-check / aggregate shadow energy price ($/kWh). LP dual from HAEO for the energy balance constraint.

shadow_load_forecast_price.description: HAEO LP dual for the load forecast constraint ($/kWh). From sensor.load_forecast_limit_shadow_price.

shadow_solar_forecast_price.description: HAEO LP dual for the solar forecast constraint ($/kWh). From sensor.solar_forecast_limit_shadow_price.

shadow_envelope_import_price.description: HAEO LP dual for the grid import envelope constraint ($/kWh). From sensor.grid_max_import_power_shadow_price. Non-zero when the import envelope is binding.

shadow_envelope_export_price.description: HAEO LP dual for the grid export envelope constraint ($/kWh). From sensor.grid_max_export_power_shadow_price. Non-zero when the export envelope is binding.

assets.description: Array of asset objects (stationary batteries and EVs).

asset_id.description: Slug identifier for this asset. Examples: 'home_battery', 'ev1', 'ev2'.

bidirectional_capable.description: Whether the asset hardware supports bidirectional power flow.

soc_pct.description: State of charge as a percentage (0-100).

setpoint_kw.description: Signed kW setpoint commanded by the optimiser. Positive = charging, negative = discharging. Null if entity unavailable.

available_up_kw.description: Available upward flexibility from this asset (kW).

available_down_kw.description: Available downward flexibility from this asset (kW).

shadow_power_balance_price.description: HAEO LP dual for this asset's power balance constraint ($/kWh). Null when asset is unavailable or unplugged.

connection_state.description: EV only. Inferred connection state (not measured from an entity). See SCHEMA.md section on connection state inference.

power_flow_capability.description: EV only. Inferred power flow capability for this interval.

departure_target_pct.description: EV only. Target SOC at departure (0-100). Null if not configured.

departure_time_utc.description: EV only. Scheduled departure time in UTC (ISO8601). Null if not configured.

deferrable_loads.description: Array of deferrable load objects. Empty for v0.3.0 default install. Schema slot reserved for v0.4.
